introduction_promises.claim: Extended-statistics selection is a physical-design problem for a supplied target workload.
introduction_promises.qualifier: CE loss, not runtime; workload supplied.

introduction_promises.claim: Statistics utility is contextual and inclusion can be non-monotone.
introduction_promises.qualifier: Observed in Census and DMV; not universal.

introduction_promises.claim: Recurring maintenance is an independent resource dimension.
Independent scores are insufficient and full native evaluation does not expose incremental dependencies.
introduction_promises.qualifier: Does not deny existing what-if methods.

introduction_promises.claim: CE-Replay specializes workload-fixed context while keeping design-dependent semantics executable.
CE-Replay provides objective and dependency oracles without a separate learned design-to-q-error model.
The prototype covers bounded PostgreSQL 16.14 MCV, FD, ScalarArray, and directed composition semantics.
introduction_promises.qualifier: No joins, arbitrary predicates, full planner, or automatic compiler.

introduction_promises.claim: Evidence spans fidelity, maintenance-aware design, incremental evaluation, composition, and fresh deployment in two workloads.
introduction_promises.qualifier: Local optimization; topology-dependent opportunity; no runtime objective.

introduction_promises.claim: The work contributes a representation/method and bounded optimizer use, not a new estimator or complete DBMS.

contribution_audit.introduce_build_show: PostgreSQL MCV+FD CE-Replay with bounded ScalarArray and composition.
Objective/dependency oracles for maintenance-constrained local search.
contribution_audit.scope: Neighborhood local optimality; no universal speedup.

contribution_audit.introduce_build_show: Cross-workload physical and fresh native validation.
contribution_audit.scope: Two workloads, PostgreSQL 16.14, no runtime claim.

abstract_promises.claim: Maintenance-constrained statistics physical design for a supplied workload.
Stateful/compositional semantics create non-monotone contextual effects.
CE-Replay yields objective and dependency oracles.
PostgreSQL 16.14 bounded MCV+FD implementation plus deterministic local search.
abstract_promises.qualifier: No joins, arbitrary predicates, or global guarantee.

abstract_promises.claim: Fresh fidelity and exact audited incremental evaluation across Census and DMV.
abstract_promises.qualifier: No universal speedup or paired DMV drift claim.

abstract_promises.claim: Executable semantics support bounded maintenance-aware design while extensions remain open.
abstract_promises.qualifier: No universal DBMS or robustness claim.
